description: This file contains the implementation of device management within a backend system for handling device registration, proxying, and client communication for Android-Cuttlefish, including device pool management, device proxy creation, and client notifications.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a physical or virtual device managed by the backend, including connection, proxy, and client management.

classes.name: preDevice
classes.description: Holds information about a device in the pre-registration phase, including its descriptor and registration channel.

classes.name: DevicePool
classes.description: Manages the collection of pre-registered and registered devices, supporting registration, unregistration, and querying.

methods.name: newDevice
methods.description: Creates a new Device instance, including setting up reverse proxy and device descriptor.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message to the device via its connection.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a new client with the device and returns a client ID.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a client from the device.

methods.name: DisconnectClients
methods.description: Notifies all registered clients that the device has disconnected.

methods.name: ToClient
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific client connected to the device.

methods.name: NewDevicePool
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DevicePool.

methods.name: PreRegister
methods.description: Pre-registers a device with its descriptor and registration channel.

methods.name: CancelPreRegistration
methods.description: Cancels pre-registration of a device by closing its registration channel.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Completes device registration, creating Device instance, and associates pre-registration info.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a device from the pool and disconnects all clients.

methods.name: GetDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a device by its ID.

methods.name: GroupIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all unique device group IDs.

methods.name: DeviceIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered device IDs.

methods.name: GetDeviceDescList
methods.description: Returns descriptions of all registered devices.

methods.name: GetDeviceDescByGroupId
methods.description: Returns device descriptions filtered by group ID.
